name: Weather Service Agent
description: Provides real-time weather data, forecasts, and climate analysis. Supports multiple locations and integrates with various weather data sources.

skills.name: Get Current Weather
skills.description: Retrieves current weather conditions for a specified location including temperature, humidity, wind speed, and conditions.
examples: What's the weather in San Francisco?

skills.name: Get Weather Forecast
skills.description: Provides weather forecast for upcoming days for a specified location.
examples: Will it rain tomorrow in Boston?
